title: MISSION 01: Shadow HR
briefing:
Target: Director Kim Cheolsu, HR Team
Difficulty: ★☆☆☆☆

Goal: Director Kim's intranet account password

Notes:
- Bad with computers and very authoritative.
- Weak to flattery and to anyone begging that something is urgent.
- Gets angry if you ask for the password outright.

request.subject: Questions about the list of successful candidates
request.body:
Please check the HR Team's recent hiring records.

I have heard that the evaluation result of one particular applicant was handled differently from the others. I do not yet know whether it was a simple correction or whether someone interfered.

Compare the evaluation sheets with the approval records, and if the originals remain, check the differences there as well.

— K

npc.name: Kim Cheolsu
npc.persona: Director of the CorpX HR Team, 20 years with the company. Authoritative and condescending, he calls people below him "young man" or "kid" (sparingly). Bad with computers and often forgets his passwords. Weak to praise and flattery, and when someone begs that something is urgent he swells with importance and tries to help. He is worried because things with his wife are not what they used to be. Speaks in short, pompous statements: "Hmm, I see.", "Heh heh", "Watch your tongue." Never apologizes.

evade: Heh heh, let's talk about that another time.
wary: Why do you keep asking about that?
angry: Who do you think you're talking to?
Watch your tongue. Keep this up and I will talk to the Security Team.
confused: Heh heh, what are you talking about?

facts.label: Director Kim's position
facts.text: I am the Director of the HR Team and I have worked at this company for 20 years.

facts.label: Computer skills
facts.text: I find computers very hard, and I often forget my passwords.

facts.label: Wife
facts.text: Lately things with my wife are not what they used to be, and it weighs on me.

facts.label: The day he first met his wife
facts.text: The day I first met my wife, we walked a long time together under the {{sky_ko}}. Anything important, I settle with those words ever since.

clues.label: Wife's mail
clues.text: His wife misses the day they first met

clues.label: Password policy
clues.text: Lowercase English words joined by underscores, ending with _{{year}}

clues.label: Director Kim's mail to himself
clues.text: He chose words full of memories with his wife as his password

inferences.label: The password is a memory with his wife
inferences.yields: Director Kim used words from the day he first met his wife in his password. Approaching him through talk about his wife looks promising.

inferences.label: Complete combination
inferences.yields: Write '{{sky_ko}}' in lowercase English words joined by an underscore, and end with _{{year}}

emails.subject: Honey, this weekend
emails.body: We've both been so busy lately. Do you remember the day we first met? I'd like us to take a long walk together like that day.

emails.subject: [Notice] {{year}} password policy
emails.body: From {{year}}, intranet passwords must be lowercase English words joined by underscores (_), with _{{year}} added at the end. Example: green_tea_{{year}}

emails.subject: RE: Password change complete
emails.body: They told me to change it again, so I did. This time I used those words that belong to my wife and me, so I won't forget. Heh heh.

emails.subject: Second-half open recruitment: final list of successful candidates
emails.body: Director, I've submitted the final list of successful candidates for approval. Please take a look.

emails.body: Get ready for winter rounds. Season sale runs until this weekend.
